title: HiveBlot: structured, provenance-tracked extraction of Western blot evidence from published figures
description:
HiveBlot reads Western blot figures together with their captions and methods text and turns each blot into lane-level evidence records. Every field in a record carries a status (supported, ambiguous, conflicting or missing) and the source wording it was drawn from; when a figure and its text disagree, the field is flagged as conflicting and left empty instead of guessed.

The software combines OpenCV panel detection, a vision-language model, and deterministic biology and UniProt reconciliation rules, and includes a search API and a web interface. This is a beta release: the reviewed corpus covers three papers, and a pre-registered blind benchmark on unseen papers is in progress, so no accuracy figures are reported here.

Figure crops from the source papers are not part of this archive and are not covered by the MIT license; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICE.md.
